name: Infinite Regression
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level adept 5, druid 5, magus 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target 1 corporeal, living creature
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Fort negates, Will negates, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You finish the spell and change the target into a primordial, un-evolved version of their species. If the target fails a Fortitude save followed by a Will save, their Intelligence drops to 2, and they lose access to skills that use Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma skills that require training. Additionally, they gain a +.

Strength and Constitution as they become more animalistic and they gain a 1d6 natural attack of their choice. The target retains class levels, feats and abilities gained but they lose the ability to use any spells or any abilities that require verbal components as they lose any linguistic capacity.

Any polymorph effects on the target are automatically dispelled when the target fails their saving throws, and as long as this spell remains in effect, the target cannot use other polymorph spells or effects to assume a new form with the exception of baleful polymorph.
